answer: The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The saffron assignment is published and garden records each panel. Shards are assigned from the umber graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 829 identities would post 3580 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
